original_ai_output.title_zh: 日立EX5500-6矿用挖掘机在莫阿蒂泽累计运行突破10万小时
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 日立建机宣布，其生产的EX5500-6超大型液压挖掘机在莫桑比克太特省莫阿蒂泽煤矿累计运行时间突破10万小时。该矿由Vulcan Mozambique SA运营，8月27日在矿区举行庆祝仪式，约80名双方官员出席。该设备于2010年6月交付，2026年7月达到这一里程碑。

location.raw_text: Moatize Coal Mine in Tete Province in the Republic of Mozambique

key_facts.fact: 日立EX5500-6超大型液压挖掘机在莫阿蒂泽煤矿累计运行突破10万小时
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: an EX5500-6 ultra-large hydraulic excavator manufactured by the company has passed 100,000 hours of operation at the Moatize Coal Mine in Tete Province in the Republic of Mozambique

key_facts.fact: 莫阿蒂泽煤矿由Vulcan Mozambique SA运营
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The mine is operated by Vulcan Mozambique SA

key_facts.fact: 8月27日在矿区举行庆祝仪式，约80名双方官员出席
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a ceremony was held at the mine on August 27. Approximately 80 Vulcan and Hitachi Construction Machinery Group officials attended the ceremony

key_facts.fact: 该设备于2010年6月交付，2026年7月达到10万小时运行里程碑
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The EX5500-6 that achieved this milestone was delivered in June 2010 and reached a cumulative 100,000 hours of operation in July 2026

uncertainties: 目前仅单一来源（Club of Mozambique）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
